experiment_art_direction.art_direction: The terrain tiles should evoke a post-apocalyptic, desolate night scene. The primary materials are dark, cracked asphalt, grey concrete, rubble, and scorched pavement, all covered in ash and soot. Lighting is minimal, emphasizing deep shadows and a muted, desaturated color palette to create a grim and oppressive mood. Textures should be highly detailed at the pixel level, showcasing fine cracks, dust, and scattered debris like glass shards and small broken bricks, maintaining a seamless and uniform appearance across all tiles.
